## Description
Please include a summary of the changes and related context.

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🎨 UI/UX improvement
- [ ] ♻️ Code refactor
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] 🔒 Security improvement

## Related Issues
Closes #[issue number]

## Testing
How have you tested this change?
- [ ] I've tested with real save files
- [ ] I've tested in multiple browsers
- [ ] No JavaScript errors in console (F12)
- [ ] Changes work offline
- [ ] Downloads/saves still work

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project's style guide
- [ ] I've commented complex logic
- [ ] I've updated documentation if needed
- [ ] No new warnings or errors
- [ ] I've tested with actual game saves
- [ ] I've backed up saves before testing

## Screenshots (if applicable)
If this is a UI change, include before/after screenshots.

## Additional Notes
Any other context or notes for reviewers?
